name: J.J. McCarthy
headline: J.J. McCarthy to start for Giants in Week 7 vs. Texans
excerpt: J.J. McCarthy will be the Giants' starting quarterback for Week 7 in Houston, coach John Harbaugh announced following Wednesday's practice at the Quest Diagnostics Training Center.

name: Jalon Daniels
headline: Jalon Daniels Will Remain Bucs' Starter in Baker Mayfield's Absence
excerpt: Jalon Daniels made his first NFL start on Sunday in a 17-14 loss to the Green Bay Packers, and after the game Head Coach Todd Bowles did not hesitate to give Daniels his stamp of approval going forward.

name: Jalon Daniels
headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield out at least 3 weeks with thumb injury; rookie Jalon Daniels to start
excerpt: Tampa Bay will start undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels in Mayfield’s place when it hosts the 1-2 Packers on Oct. 4.

name: Bucky Irving / Sean Tucker / Kenny Gainwell
headline: Todd Bowles: Bucs Need to Split Backfield Reps Three Ways
excerpt: Bucky Irving led the Buccaneers in rushing with 61 yards and was a catalyst in that second successful possession, the team's longest touchdown drive of the season so far, carrying the ball on five of the 12 plays. Rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels ended that drive with a scrambling third-down pass to Kenny Gainwell, who caught the ball at the first-down sticks and then dived into the end zone. Earlier in the game, Sean Tucker got the Bucs on the board and temporarily tied things up, 7-7, with a rugged two-year touchdown run.

name: Zach Charbonnet
headline: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet Designated To Return To Practice
excerpt: Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet, who opened the season on the physically unable to perform list, has been designated to return to practice, clearing the way for him to take part in football activities starting Thursday.

name: Zach Ertz
headline: Eagles elevate Josiah Deguara, Zach Ertz for Sunday's game
excerpt: The Eagles elevated two players from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams – tight ends Josiah Deguara and Zach Ertz.

name: J.J. McCarthy
headline: Giants to start J.J. McCarthy at quarterback in Week 7 vs. Texans
excerpt: John Harbaugh and the New York Giants are making another change at quarterback. J.J. McCarthy will start for the Giants in Week 7 on the road against the Houston Texans on Sunday, Harbaugh confirmed Wednesday.
